sentences.pt: Onde fica a farmácia mais próxima?

sentences.en: Do you have something for a cold?
sentences.pt: Tem alguma coisa para a constipação?

sentences.en: I've had a fever since yesterday.

passages.text: Tómese una pastilla cada ocho horas, siempre después de comer, durante cinco días. Si mañana todavía tiene fiebre o le duele más la garganta, vuelva o vaya directamente al centro de salud.
passages.en: Take one tablet every eight hours, always after eating, for five days. If you still have a fever tomorrow or your throat hurts more, come back or go straight to the health centre.
passages.question: What are the instructions?
passages.answer: One tablet every eight hours after meals for five days. Come back if it gets worse.
wrong: Eight tablets a day, before meals.
One tablet at night only, for eight days.

passages.text: Tome um comprimido de oito em oito horas, sempre depois das refeições, durante cinco dias. Se amanhã ainda tiver febre ou se a garganta piorar, volte cá ou vá diretamente ao centro de saúde.
passages.en: Take one tablet every eight hours, always after meals, for five days. If you still have a fever tomorrow or your throat gets worse, come back or go straight to the health centre.

passages.answer: One tablet every eight hours after meals for five days. Come back if it gets worse.
